market.summary: Nifty closed at a one-month high on a third straight gain, but one stock did much of the work: Reliance added about 198 of the Nifty's points after its results. Crude fell on hopes of Iran-Qatar talks to reopen the Strait of Hormuz, which helps Indian consumers and costs. Small caps gained much less than the Nifty, and the screener's NIFTY 500 regime was last read as RISK-OFF (below its 50 and 200 DMA, data to 30 Oct), so a one-day rally does not yet change the size-down message.

points.text: Reliance +11.6% to Rs 1,300 on better refining and petrochemical margins, about 198 Nifty points. Energy +3.92%, Metal +3.21%; IT -0.50%, Media -0.76% (weakest).
Brent fell 4.2% to $108.68 on 2 Nov; Iran's foreign minister said negotiators in Qatar were discussing a proposal that could reopen Hormuz within two days, with no direct US talks.
FIIs bought Rs 3,598.54 Cr in cash on Friday; rupee about flat at 94.90 per dollar; US futures were up after Friday's Nasdaq -2.86%.

market.watch: Whether Hormuz talks hold (crude) and whether small caps join the rally; the next NIFTY 500 close against its 50 DMA (about 22,565).

GROWW.summary: No new filing, deal or company news. Groww rose 2.5% to 196.31 in a strong market, so it moved further above the 188.75 stop but is still below entry at -0.37R. US broker peers fell hard on Friday, yet the stock ignored it, which is a mild plus for the trade.

points.text: Close Rs 196.31 vs Rs 191.52 Friday; entry Rs 200.80, stop Rs 188.75, +1R Rs 212.85; delivery 70%.
Robinhood -7.2% and Interactive Brokers -6.0% on Friday 30 Oct; no Groww bulk, block or short deal in 10 days.
Selling pressure reads accumulation: 5 accumulation days vs 1 distribution day in 25 sessions; weekly RSI shows a bullish divergence.

GROWW.watch: A close back above entry 200.80; the stop stays 188.75.

SEJALLTD.summary: No new filing or company news. Sejal bounced 0.7% to 778.55 on very thin volume (0.13x normal), which does not repair the damage: the close is still 7% under the 838.03 stop, so the plan's closing-basis exit signal stands at -2.29R. Monthly RSI still shows a bearish divergence.

points.text: Close Rs 778.55 vs Rs 773.45 Friday; average cost Rs 884.13, stop Rs 838.03: -2.29R (-11.9%).
Last filing is the 27 Oct call transcript; no deals in 10 days. Global glass peers were mixed (Saint-Gobain +2.3%).

SEJALLTD.watch: The trade is still open in My trades with an exit signal; a low-volume bounce is not a reclaim of 838.

THELEELA.summary: Leela jumped 5.8% to 671.05 on 3.2x volume, a new all-time high, with no company filing or news found behind it, so this is price and volume supporting the drift. The trade is +2.14R and has passed +2R, with the stop at cost. The close is about 11.6% above the 21 EMA and weekly RSI is overbought (71), so a pause would be normal.

points.text: Close Rs 671.05 vs Rs 634.25 Friday; entry Rs 604.51, stop at cost Rs 604.51, 21 EMA Rs 601; +2R was Rs 666.81.
New 52-week and all-time high on 2 Nov, ahead of its sector, with no specific announcement reported.
Accumulation: 10 accumulation days vs 2 distribution days in 25 sessions; last filing is the 22 Oct call transcript.

THELEELA.watch: The plan trails at cost / 21 EMA on a closing basis; the gap to that stop is now wide.

INDHOTEL.summary: No new company news. Indian Hotels added 1.3% to 822.50 on normal volume, its peak close so far and just under +1R. The analyst meet schedule filed Friday (file name dated 5 Nov) could not be opened here, so its content is not verified; such schedules are normally routine. Weekly RSI is at 70, overbought.

points.text: Close Rs 822.50 vs entry Rs 785.83: +0.81R (+4.7%); stop Rs 740.47 until +1R at Rs 831.19.
Filing 30 Oct 17:38 IST: schedule of an analyst / institutional meet (attachment named for 5 Nov).

INDHOTEL.watch: A close at or above 831.19 moves the stop to cost.

TIPSMUSIC.summary: No new filing or company news. Tips held 784.95 (+0.4%) on thin volume on a day Media was the weakest sector, so it is holding up relative to its group. The stop is at cost (727.89) since +1R was reached on 28 Oct.

points.text: Close Rs 784.95 vs entry Rs 727.89: +0.87R (+7.8%); stop at cost, 21 EMA Rs 727; volume 0.36x normal.
Nifty Media -0.76% on 2 Nov while the Nifty rose 1.68%.

TIPSMUSIC.watch: A close above the 793.90 peak resumes the move.

ORIENTELEC.summary: No new company news. Orient Electric rose 1.0% to 182.47, just above its 21 EMA, on light volume in a market that favoured energy and metals. Dixon jumped after its results, but that says little about fans and lighting. The trade is -0.31R with the stop well below at 171.27.

points.text: Dixon Technologies climbed over 12% after Q2 FY27 results.
Last filing is the 22 Oct call transcript; no deals in 10 days.

ORIENTELEC.watch: A close back above entry 187.44; a close under the 21 EMA (about 180.5) would be the first sign of weakness.
